evidence.quote: You check, and the dealer checks behind you, so there's no bet to call.
Dealing a new hand. Bankroll stands at 1,050 chips.

criteria.why: All replies use short, plain dealer language with no JSON, ids, or talk about tools.

evidence.quote: You discard the 2 and 4 of clubs and draw the 8 of hearts and queen of diamonds.
You folded your pair of jacks. No chips moved

criteria.why: Each reply acts on the move: the check, the discard, the 50 bet, the fold and the stand pat. One slip: at turn 5 the player folded and the reply says 'No chips moved', which glosses over the lack of any ante or bet.

evidence.quote: The dealer calls your 50, and we turn the hands over.
You check, the dealer checks behind you, and we turn the hands over.

criteria.why: The dealer plays its own actions, reveals the hands, and settles the pot every time. The player's choices stay with the player, and the discards were chosen by the player.

evidence.quote: Your King high beats the dealer's Queen high

criteria.why: Totals and bankroll are consistent across replies and surface text. One small slip: in turn 3 the reply says 'King high' while the surface lists K-Q-9-8-7, and in turn 5 the dealer 'wins the empty pot' when the player folded.
